primitives.name: Posterior Edge Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Engine edge, week 3 The edge is the sum of prior times signal across the whole table.
primitives.assumptions: Signals are conditionally independent; priors are normalized probabilities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When signal variance exceeds prior uncertainty, edge diverges.

layer2.mapping: Edge operator mirrors Bayesian posterior update in GSI; maps to conformal prediction via Brier score.

primitives.name: Shrinkage-Adjusted Efficiency Blend
primitives.verbatim_quote: On-field efficiency is a shrunk opponent-adjusted blend: 55% pass EPA residual, 15% rush EPA residual, 15% CPOE, 10% explosive-pass rate, 5% interception luck.
primitives.assumptions: Linear combination weights reflect empirical shrinkage estimates; residuals are opponent-adjusted.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When opponent strength varies significantly, shrinkage biases toward league average.

layer2.mapping: Efficiency blend encodes player performance under opponent adjustment; used in GSE state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Residual variance of adjusted EPA metrics.

primitives.name: Signal Prior Modifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: Airwave is in the edge at a prior of 0.05.
primitives.assumptions: Fixed prior value; represents latent signal strength.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If signal strength below threshold, Airwave contributes minimal edge.

layer2.mapping: Airwave acts as a fixed bias term in GSI edge computation; influences GSE transition probability.
layer2.telemetry: Change in edge when Airwave is toggled.

reasoning_traces.think:
The edge operator aggregates prior beliefs with observed signals, forming a posterior belief structure. Dark families contribute zero, implying null hypotheses or inactive variables. The on-field efficiency blend uses shrinkage to adjust for opponent strength, combining multiple performance metrics into a single scalar. This blend is a derived kernel that reflects player skill in context. Airwave introduces a fixed prior, acting as a latent signal modifier. These primitives form a coherent Bayesian framework where GSI computes posterior beliefs and GSE transitions states based on these structured signals. Failure modes include overfitting due to shrinkage bias or misalignment between signal and prior. Dualities emerge in how prior and signal interact—when signal is strong, prior becomes less influential; when weak, prior dominates. The system's robustness depends on calibration of shrinkage and proper handling of dark families.
